name: org.newsatoshi.commons/newsatoshi-commons
title: Newsatoshi Commons & Multi-Chain Crypto Tools
description: Zero-auth EVM security audit, Bitcoin mempool, BOLT-11 decoder, Base Uniswap V3 & Newsatoshi LOVE.

tools.name: newsatoshi_get_network_status
tools.description: Fetch live Newsatoshi L1 Mainnet and Testnet status (block height, tip hash, difficulty, issued LOVE, open locks, peers, AuxPoW chainid 20051).

refresh.description: Bypass 5s cache and poll live L1 nodes directly.

tools.name: newsatoshi_get_commons_state
tools.description: Return live NEWSATOSHI/2.1 Commons treasury state, covenant_rule_hash, cold-ceremony public roots, verified STARK proofs, L1 anchors, and non-custodial swaps.

tools.name: newsatoshi_compile_btc_love_swap
tools.description: Compile a trustless multi-chain SHA-256 HTLC atomic swap into LOVE: Bitcoin BIP-199 P2WSH (bc1q...), Lightning BOLT-11, Solana SOL/USDC PDA escrow, or EVM ETH/POL/USDC HTLC (live Sourcify-verified contract 0xF564A8F600B02981Bc02aC62a2B7d0C8dC638987 across Base, Arbitrum One, Optimism & Polygon).

btc_current_height.description: Optional current BTC tip for anti-race margin check

btc_locktime.description: Bitcoin CLTV block height or Unix timestamp

evm_chain.description: Target EVM chain (Base, Arbitrum, Optimism & Polygon default to live verified 0xF564A8F600B02981Bc02aC62a2B7d0C8dC638987)

evm_contract_address.description: Optional override; Base/Arbitrum/Optimism/Polygon default to live verified 0xF564A8F600B02981Bc02aC62a2B7d0C8dC638987

love_claim_address.description: Newsatoshi ns1... or nsd1... claim address

tools.name: newsatoshi_verify_onchain_lock
tools.description: Verify a SHA-256 hash-lock live on Newsatoshi Mainnet or Testnet (/api/lock?hash=), optionally check Bitcoin P2WSH funding on mempool.space, and optionally verify SHA256(preimage) == hash.

btc_address.description: Optional Bitcoin bc1q... or tb1q... P2WSH address

tools.name: newsatoshi_verify_payword_402
tools.description: Verify a post-quantum pure-SHA-256 PayWord HTTP 402 micropayment token (checks SHA256^ticks(token) == tip in microseconds with zero gas).

tools.name: newsatoshi_verify_stark_proof
tools.description: Cryptographically re-verify a Winterfell 0.13 STARK covenant transition proof stored on this Commons node.

tools.name: newsatoshi_agent_quickstart
tools.description: Return step-by-step zero-human setup commands for an AI agent to create a shielded Newsatoshi nsd1... wallet, get free testnet LOVE from the faucet, swap BTC<->LOVE on mainnet, and transact via HTTP 402 PayWord or L1 compute jobs.

tools.name: newsatoshi_create_402_challenge
tools.description: Generate a standard NEWSATOSHI-402/1.0 Payment Required challenge (L1 hash-lock + pure-SHA-256 PayWord stream) so any AI agent or developer can monetize their own API or tool in LOVE with zero KYC.

recipient.description: Recipient Newsatoshi ns1... or nsd1... address

tools.name: newsatoshi_get_mining_economics
tools.description: Return real-time Newsatoshi Mainnet & Testnet derived hashrate, AuxPoW merge-mined %, supply mined %, and snapshot merge-mining yield for any SHA-256 ASIC hashrate (Bitaxe, NerdQAxe, Antminer S19/S21) at zero extra electricity cost.

hashrate_ths.description: Miner SHA-256 hashrate in TH/s (e.g. 1.2 for Bitaxe Gamma, 200 for Antminer S21)

tools.name: newsatoshi_get_backing_proof
tools.description: Fetch live verifiable multi-chain Proof-of-Backing reserves across the ownerless NewsatoshiBackingVault.sol (0x37Ed94525DBE408fA72cDd156409875666679265) on Base, Arbitrum, Optimism & Polygon plus live Newsatoshi L1 supply, RWA deeds, and backing-per-LOVE ratios.

tools.name: newsatoshi_spawn_charter
tools.description: Compile a sovereign Web4 Autonomous Business Charter with Lean 4-verified monotonic child spending caps, exact basis-point ops/reinvest/backing splits (summing to 10000), ERC-8004 dual identity JSON, and ready-to-run NewsatoshiBackingVault.sol anchor/deposit commands.

parent_charter_id.description: Optional parent charter_id; enforces Lean 4 monotonic cap & backing_bps inheritance

tools.name: newsatoshi_list_charters
tools.description: List all persisted sovereign Web4 business charters with their covenant_rule_hash, backing_bps, lineage depth, and ERC-8004 URIs.

tools.name: newsatoshi_discover_services
tools.description: Discover live HTTP 402 PayWord & x402 paid AI/compute/data services registered by Web4 businesses, optionally filtered by capability tag.

capability.description: Optional capability tag filter (e.g. inference, compute, stark, audit)

tools.name: newsatoshi_list_bounties
tools.description: List open zero-custody work & compute bounties backed by Newsatoshi L1 Freivalds jobs or multi-chain SHA-256 HTLC locks.

tools.name: crypto_inspect_evm_contract
tools.description: Zero-API-key live EVM smart-contract security audit across Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, Optimism & Polygon: inspects bytecode size, EIP-1967 upgradeable proxy slots, active owner() privilege, ERC-20 metadata, native balance, and live Sourcify source verification.

tools.name: crypto_bitcoin_mempool_oracle
tools.description: Zero-API-key live Bitcoin Mainnet fee rate oracle (sat/vB for fastest/30m/1h/economy), current tip block height, mempool backlog size, and optional Bitcoin address confirmed/unconfirmed balance lookup via mempool.space.

address.description: Optional Bitcoin address (bc1q..., bc1p..., 1..., 3...) for live balance & tx count lookup

tools.name: crypto_decode_bolt11_invoice
tools.description: Instant sub-millisecond pure-Rust Lightning Network BOLT-11 invoice decoder: extracts network, SHA-256 payment_hash, exact satoshi & millisatoshi amount, expiry, timestamp, and description.

invoice.description: Lightning BOLT-11 invoice string (lnbc..., lntb..., lnbcrt...)

tools.name: crypto_quote_base_uniswap_v3
tools.description: Fetch a live on-chain Base Mainnet Uniswap V3 QuoterV2 swap quote and live pool reserves for ETH <-> wLOVE or USDC <-> wLOVE (including 2-hop USDC -> WETH -> wLOVE).

amount.description: Human-readable decimal amount (e.g. '0.001' ETH or '1' USDC)

tools.name: crypto_verify_tx_receipt
tools.description: Zero-API-key cross-chain transaction finality & confirmation checker across Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, Optimism, Polygon, and Bitcoin Mainnet.

tx_hash.description: Transaction hash (0x... for EVM or 64-hex txid for Bitcoin)

tools.name: newsatoshi_inspect_trust_bond
tools.description: Query an RFC-0024 L1 Universal Trust Bond (active LOVE collateral stake, settled volume, slash history, arbiter quorum, and canonical Merkle proof) from an L1 node or return the RFC-0024 substrate schema.

seed_url.description: Optional L1 node base URL (defaults to live Mainnet seed)

tools.name: newsatoshi_inspect_rollup_vault
tools.description: Query an RFC-0023 Sovereign L2 Rollup Vault (vk_hash, state_root, deposit_acc, TVL, settled L2 tx count, withdraw_roots, and canonical Merkle proof) from an L1 node.

seed_url.description: Optional L1 node base URL (defaults to live Mainnet seed)

tools.name: newsatoshi_get_protocol_signaling
tools.description: Query RFC-0026 live BIP-9 collective protocol signaling & base-layer monetary ossification telemetry from an L1 node.

seed_url.description: Optional L1 node base URL (defaults to live Mainnet seed)

tools.name: newsatoshi_create_scoped_session_policy
tools.description: Compile a deterministic RFC-0025 policy-constrained AI agent session policy (max_per_call, max_per_hour, max_total, min_counterparty_bond, profit_sweep_address, expiry) and canonical SHA-256 policy digest without exposing root spending keys.

max_counterparty_slashes.description: Maximum tolerated slash count on counterparties (default 0)

max_per_call.description: Max spend per call in base units (1 LOVE = 100,000,000)

max_per_hour.description: Sliding 1-hour spend cap in base units

max_total.description: Lifetime session spend cap in base units

min_counterparty_bond.description: Minimum RFC-0024 L1 Trust Bond stake required on counterparties

profit_sweep_address.description: Shielded ns1.../nsd1... address for automated profit sweeps

tools.name: newsatoshi_launch_agent_mission
tools.description: Compile a deterministic RFC-0027 Native Mission Launchpad & Decentralized AI Agent Swarm charter (pequalnp.money-style): dual zero-rugpull bounty_pool + bonding curve_reserve, 0% founder take, automatic contributor/public-goods split (e.g. 80/20), optional RFC-0024 anti-Sybil Trust Bond gate, and 1-line external agent MCP join snippet.

contributor_bps.description: Contributor payout share in basis points (must sum with public_goods_bps to 10000; 0% founder take)

curve_fee_bps.description: Bonding-curve buy/sell fee routed 100% into bounty_pool (max 1000 = 10%)

initial_funding_base_units.description: Initial bounty pool funding in base units (1 LOVE = 100,000,000)

min_worker_bond_base_units.description: Optional RFC-0024 Trust Bond minimum stake required to claim tasks (anti-Sybil)

mission_brief.description: Objective, verification rule, and deliverables (8..=1200 chars)

name.description: Mission name (2..=80 chars, e.g. 'Open P vs NP Lean 4 Swarm')

public_goods_address.description: Shielded ns1... or nsd1... public-goods beneficiary address

public_goods_bps.description: Public-goods treasury share in basis points (e.g. 2000 = 20% to Lean FRO)

repo_url.description: Optional open-source repository URL for agent pull requests / proofs

swarm_roles.description: Swarm role topology (defaults to orchestrator, prover, red_team, checker_desk)

verifier_kind.description: Verification rule (lean4_zero_sorry, unit_tests, stark_proof, zktls_receipt, quorum_review)

tools.name: newsatoshi_quote_launchpad_curve
tools.description: Compute an exact integer RFC-0027 Mission Launchpad bonding-curve buy or redeem quote matching Newsatoshi L1 (node/src/mission.rs) and Lean 4 Theorem 9 conservation 1:1 (100% of curve_fee_bps routes straight into bounty_pool, 0% founder extraction).

amount.description: Input LOVE base units (required when side='buy')

curve_fee_bps.description: Fee in bps routed into bounty_pool on every trade (max 1000)

miner_fee.description: Optional L1 miner fee in base units (for side='redeem')

side.description: Quote direction: buy shares into curve or redeem shares from curve

tools.name: newsatoshi_inspect_mission_launchpad
tools.description: Query an RFC-0027 Native Mission Launchpad on an L1 node (/api/mission?id=...): returns live bounty_pool, curve_reserve, total_shares, contributor/public-goods split, open/claimed tasks, min_worker_bond, and canonical Merkle proof.

seed_url.description: Optional L1 node base URL (defaults to live Mainnet seed)

tools.name: newsatoshi_format_swarm_task_claim
tools.description: Compute deterministic L1 RFC-0027 post_task_message (nsMISSTASK) and claim_task_message (nsMISSCLAIM) SHA-256 signing digests for FIPS 205 checker-desk quorum task posting and verified bounty payouts.

contributor_apk_hex.description: Optional 64-hex shielded contributor apk (required to compute claim_task_message_hex)

miner_fee.description: L1 miner fee deducted from gross reward on claim

proof_hash_hex.description: Optional 64-hex SHA-256 hash of verified proof artifact (required to compute claim_task_message_hex)

reward.description: Gross task bounty in base units (split automatically by contributor_bps/public_goods_bps)

spec_hash_hex.description: 64-hex SHA-256 hash of the task specification / theorem statement
